label: Bible Study
prompt: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy _____; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
verse: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
note: Whatever's in your hands, give it full effort — there's no second shift after this life.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jonathan said to David, Go in _____, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
verse: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
note: Jonathan's goodbye to his best friend David: go in peace — their friendship sworn before the LORD.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing _____ he went.
verse: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
note: Abraham obeyed and left home 'not knowing whither he went' — the first great road trip without a map.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The _____ are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verse: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
note: The measuring lines marked out David's lot — and he says he drew the best property in the world.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Therefore, behold, I will _____ her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
verse: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
note: God's plan for wayward Israel: 'I will allure her' into the wilderness and 'speak comfortably unto her.' Divine courtship.
